variable_sources.age: Whole years from BIRTHDATE to the reference date 2026-10-01
variable_sources.crcl: Derived: Cockcroft-Gault from the latest creatinine, age, weight and sex
variable_sources.prior_systemic_lines: Derived: antineoplastic medication orders; a gap of more than 90 days starts a new line
variable_sources.cardiac_disease: Active heart failure, atrial fibrillation, unstable angina, cardiomyopathy, aortic/mitral stenosis, or a myocardial infarction starting within 180 days (stable ischemic disease excluded)
variable_sources.uncontrolled_hypertension: Derived: active hypertension diagnosis and latest BP >= 160 systolic or >= 100 diastolic
variable_sources.thromboembolic_event_recent: Stroke, embolism or thrombosis diagnosis starting within 180 days
variable_sources.active_infection: Acute infectious condition active on the reference date
variable_sources.prior_malignancy: Any Synthea-simulated cancer diagnosis (in situ and suspected excluded)
variable_sources.systemic_immunosuppression: Active systemic steroid or immunosuppressant medication

not_simulated.ecog: Synthea does not record performance status.
not_simulated.anc: Synthea records total white cells (6690-2) but not absolute neutrophil count.
not_simulated.brain_mets: Synthea's lung cancer module does not record CNS metastases.
not_simulated.hepatitis_b: Synthea has no hepatitis B disease module (only screening).
not_simulated.hepatitis_c: Synthea has no hepatitis C disease module (only screening).
not_simulated.ibd: Synthea has no inflammatory bowel disease module.
not_simulated.hepatic_impairment: Synthea has no cirrhosis/liver failure module.
not_simulated.interstitial_lung_disease: Synthea has no interstitial lung disease module.
not_simulated.drug_hypersensitivity: Hypersensitivity to a specific investigational drug cannot be known.
not_simulated.recent_major_surgery: Not derived: classifying 'major' surgery from procedure codes is not reliable.
not_simulated.prior_immunotherapy: Synthea does not simulate checkpoint inhibitors or other immunotherapy.
not_simulated.egfr_mutation_positive: Synthea does not simulate tumor biomarkers.
not_simulated.alk_positive: Synthea does not simulate tumor biomarkers.
